10. 您可以根据度小满客户端的支付授权管理设置指引或通过度小满客服热线申请提前终止本服务。您理解并同意,为了维护您和特定第三方的合法权益,您申请终止本服务可能需要满足一定的条件(如不存在未完结的交易订单或未完结的付款义务)。若有任何疑问,可拨打度小满支付客服电话95055咨询 。

So not enabling fingerprint, using password/verification code, normal functions unaffected. Adds that specific page login options depend on App actual display. Offers to send download SMS.

The policy says not providing certain information may cause inability to use or abnormal use of "本服务" but won't affect using other platform services. So if a specific verification requires fingerprint, not enabling could affect that specific verification. The agent did add "具体页面上的登录方式选项，要以 App 实际显示为准" as caveat. Hmm. The statement "不开指纹，用密码或验证码登录，正常功能不受影响" is a bit of an overgeneralization — the policy says in special cases the payment institution may require fingerprint verification for transaction security.
